layman_headline: The market just rallied hard — now it's time to manage what we have, not chase more.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin surged 22% this week and most altcoins followed with even bigger moves. Our Solana position is up 7.5% and approaching our $100 profit target. Our XRP position is underwater at -6.4% but still well above its stop-loss. Every swing candidate on the board has already made a massive move this week (35-81% gains), making new entries extremely risky right now — we'd be buying at the top of a squeeze rally.
layman_action: Hold current positions. Let SOL ride toward the $100 target. Watch XRP closely — if it drops below $1.30, exit. Do not chase any of the overextended coins right now.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate shows deeply negative composite scores driven by overextension: PUMP at RSI 82 with +81% in 7 days, TRUMP +70%, XRP +45.8%, ZEC +64.7%. The market-wide squeeze has left no clean entry points. BTC dominance at 59.3% remains unfavorable for alt entries. Fear & Greed dropped from 71 to 66 in 24 hours while the weekly average is only 55.6 — this suggests the greed impulse may be peaking. The prudent play is to manage existing positions: SOL is 6.6% from its $100 target, and XRP needs monitoring as it's pulled back from its entry. No new capital should be deployed into assets that have already moved 25-80% in a single week.
risk_factors: XRP is down 6.4% from entry and could deteriorate further if the rally fades — $1.30 stop-loss is the line in the sand
SOL could reverse sharply from the $93-95 zone if profit-taking accelerates after the massive weekly rally
BTC dominance at 59.3% means capital is flowing to Bitcoin, not alts — prolonged BTC strength could drag alt positions lower
watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance — take profits if it touches $100
XRP behavior around $1.40 support — if it breaks below $1.35, consider early exit before stop-loss
ZEC momentum and Grayscale ETF filing developments — could become a pullback entry if it corrects 15-20% from $800
market_context: A massive short-squeeze rally lifted BTC 22% and alts 25-65% this week, but 24-hour reversals of 2-4% suggest the initial thrust is exhausting. High BTC dominance at 59.3% warns that alt outperformance may be short-lived.
context_banner: Post-squeeze consolidation phase — protect gains and wait for pullback entries rather than chasing overextended moves.

key_signals.description: PUMP's RSI at 82 confirms broad overbought conditions across swing candidates — no safe entries available right now.
Fear & Greed at 66 (down from 71 yesterday) with weekly avg at 55.6 suggests the greed spike may be peaking and a cooldown is likely.
ZEC at $2.2B daily volume and XRP at $11.3B confirm the squeeze was volume-driven, but 24h reversals suggest exhaustion.
Grayscale's Zcash spot ETF filing with 2.5% fee and potential 34% DCG stake is a legitimate catalyst — ZEC could be worth entering on a pullback.
Bitcoin and Ether bears 'decimated' in squeeze-led rally confirms this was a positioning-driven move rather than fundamental — heightens reversal risk.
